items.q: Do I need to be home during a session?
items.a: For The Edit, yes. Decisions about what to keep are yours. For The Arrange and The Reset, we can work independently once the plan is set.

items.q: What happens to items I release?
items.a: Donations go to local organizations. Items for resale or recycling are sorted and handled with you.

items.q: Are the botanical products safe for pets and children?
items.a: Yes. Products are made from herbs and plant-based ingredients with no synthetic fragrance.

items.q: Do you purchase containers and supplies?
items.a: Yes. We source containers to fit your space and style, billed at cost or within an agreed budget.
